reasons: Aggregation differs: Datadog sum:system.net.bytes_sent sums across all series, but the candidate uses avg(...), which divides by the number of interfaces and yields a per-interface average instead of the total. The correct form is sum(rate(...)).
Quantity and filter match: system.network.io with system_network_direction="transmit" is the bytes-sent quantity, and the label is observed in the dataset, so the dotted-to-underscore name is valid.
Unit and rate usage are sound: system.network.io is a monotonic sum in bytes (By), so rate() over $__rate_interval gives bytes per second, matching the per-second display.
Grouping matches (none in Datadog, none in candidate). The scope template variable has no prefix and default '*', so dropping it is correct.
